description:
Fetch a graph artifact by its digest, the same lookup that `rover graph-artifact fetch --digest` performs.
A graph artifact is the build output, such as the composed supergraph schema, that GraphOS Router fetches from Apollo's OCI registry.
Returns the artifact's ID, digest, status (GRAPH_ARTIFACT_COMPLETED, GRAPH_ARTIFACT_PENDING, or GRAPH_ARTIFACT_FAILED), build errors, timestamps, variant, the launch that produced it, its registry URI, and the tags assigned to it.
To find a digest from a tag name, use GetGraphArtifactTags.
Provide the graph ID and the digest.

digest.description: The digest (SHA) of the graph artifact

graphId.description: The ID of the graph the graph artifact belongs to

name: GetGraphArtifact
